Chip Industry Technical Paper Roundup: Nov. 25

Shares

Hybrid-bonded 3D NAND analog IMC; defect-aware chiplet matching for HI yield; HBF latency reduction for GPU systems; backside clock meshes for BSPDN; LLM-agent verification for post-quantum HW; self-supervised CMP virtual metrology; e-beam stitching losses in SOI waveguides.

November 25th, 2026 -

By: Linda Christensen

New technical papers recently added to Semiconductor Engineering’s library:

Technical Paper
Research Organizations

Arizona State University, Ampere Computing

SlipStream: Enabling HBF for GPU Systems by Mitigating the Latency and SRAM Overheads

Clock Distribution Network with Backside Clock Mesh in BSPDN Architecture
